coordinateSystem: Original DAMIT co-rotating Cartesian frame, +Z spin pole and +X reference meridian; east-positive longitude; arbitrary display phase
source: DAMIT model 4390, version 2020-01-28: ecliptic J2000 pole (132, -86) degrees; period 6.53679 hours; equatorial conversion with obliquity 23.439291111 degrees. The nonconvex model, fitted to light curves and radar delay-Doppler images, resolves large concavities where those data constrain them; craters and fine relief are unresolved.
